جِزْمَةٌ A hundred [head] of cattle, and upwards: or from ten to forty: (K:) or it is peculiarly of
camels; like صِرْمَةٌ: (TA:) or such a portion as is termed صِرْمَة of camels; and such as is termed فِرْقَة of sheep. (S, K.) [See also 8.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
